result.instructions: Tools for Timetastic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is off this week?"; "List the leave requests waiting for approval."; "How much holiday allowance does user 12 have left this year?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timetastic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timetastic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timetastic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timetastic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timetastic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timetastic_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (employees) of the Timetastic organisation, optionally by department or including archived users. Timetastic API: GET /api/users.

department_id.description: Only users in this department id.

tools.name: timetastic_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user (employee) by id, with leave and profile details. Timetastic API: GET /api/users/{id}.

tools.name: timetastic_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: List the leave types of the organisation (holiday, sickness and other types), with their ids. Timetastic API: GET /api/leavetypes.

tools.name: timetastic_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests (holidays and other bookings) in a date range, filtered by user, department or leave type. Pending and approved requests by default. Timetastic API: GET /api/holidays.

start.description: Only requests on or after this date.

end.description: Only requests on or before this date.

department_id.description: Only requests of this department id.

leave_type_id.description: Only requests of this leave type id.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Each page holds up to 100 leave requests.

tools.name: timetastic_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get leave request
tools.description: Get one leave request by id, with its status, dates and duration. Timetastic API: GET /api/holidays/{id}.

tools.name: timetastic_list_absences
tools.title: Who is off
tools.description: List the wallchart entries for a date range: who is off (bookings, public holidays, non-working days). Timetastic API: GET /api/absences.

start.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

query_type.description: What to return: AllEvents (default), AllAbsences, Bookings or PublicHolidays.

tools.name: timetastic_list_public_holidays
tools.title: List public holidays
tools.description: List the public holidays of the organisation, optionally for one country or year. Timetastic API: GET /api/publicholidays.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code, for example GB.

tools.name: timetastic_get_user_allowance
tools.title: Get user allowance
tools.description: Get one user's leave allowance, TOIL and carry-forward for a year. Timetastic API: GET /api/users/{userId}/allowances/{year}.

tools.name: timetastic_request_leave
tools.title: Request leave
tools.description: WRITE: submit a leave request (booking) in Timetastic for a user, department or everyone. Timetastic applies its own allowance, lock and approval rules, and never overrides them. Refused requests return an error with the reason. Timetastic API: POST /api/holidays.

user_id.description: The user the leave is for (when book_for is User).

from_time.description: Start time for hour-based leave, for example 09:00.

to_time.description: End time for hour-based leave, for example 13:00.

reason.description: Optional reason shown on the request.

suppress_emails.description: Do not send Timetastic notification emails (default false).

tools.name: timetastic_approve_or_decline_leave
tools.title: Approve or decline leave
tools.description: WRITE: approve or decline a pending leave request by id. Declining needs a reason. Cancelling and deleting are not offered. Timetastic API: POST /api/holidays/{id}?holidayUpdateAction=Approve|Decline.

suppress_emails.description: Do not send Timetastic notification emails (default false).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Timetastic
prompts.description: What you can do with Timetastic here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_who_is_off_in_a_date_range
prompts.title: See who is off in a date range
prompts.description: List the wallchart entries for a date range. The result shows who is off, including bookings and public holidays. Look up a user for details.

prompts.name: review_leave_requests_and_their_status
prompts.title: Review leave requests and their status
prompts.description: List the leave requests in a date range, with pending and approved requests by default. Open one request to read its status, dates and duration.

prompts.name: check_a_user_s_allowance_before_booking_leave
prompts.title: Check a user's allowance before booking leave
prompts.description: Read one user's leave allowance, TOIL and carry-forward for a year. List the leave types to see which types can be booked.

prompts.name: plan_around_public_holidays
prompts.title: Plan around public holidays
prompts.description: List the public holidays of the organisation, by country code or year, to plan leave around them.

prompts.name: request_approve_or_decline_leave
prompts.title: Request, approve or decline leave
prompts.description: Submit a leave request for a user. Approve or decline a pending request by id; declining needs a reason. Timetastic applies its own allowance and approval rules.
